title: Chipperfield JET51AD 3-In-1 Self-Propelled Petrol Lawn Mower (51cm)
description_html:
Chipperfield JET51AD Petrol Lawn Mower

The Chipperfield JET51AD is a versatile, high-performance petrol lawn mower designed to deliver outstanding cutting results across medium to large gardens. Combining powerful performance with practical features, it gives you the flexibility to tackle everything from regular lawn maintenance to overgrown grass with ease.

51cm Cutting Width – Cover More Ground Faster

With a generous 51cm (20″) cutting width, the JET51-AD cuts a wider path with every pass, reducing the number of runs needed to mow your lawn. This makes it an excellent choice for medium to large-sized gardens, helping you complete mowing tasks more efficiently while maintaining a consistent, professional-looking finish.

Grass Collection Box with Full Indicator

The mower is equipped with a large-capacity grass collection box that gathers clippings as you mow, leaving your lawn clean and tidy. This is ideal for creating a manicured appearance and preventing cut grass from being left behind on the surface.

A built-in grass box full indicator takes the guesswork out of mowing by clearly showing when the collector is reaching capacity. This helps maintain optimal collection performance and saves unnecessary stops to check the box.

Mulching Function with Included Mulch Plug

The included mulch plug transforms the mower into an effective mulching machine. Instead of collecting grass clippings, the mower finely cuts them into tiny particles and redistributes them back into the lawn.

This process offers several benefits:

  • Eliminates the need to empty the grass collector.
  • Leaves no visible clippings on the lawn.
  • Returns valuable nutrients and moisture back into the soil.
  • Helps promote a healthier, greener lawn.
  • Reduces garden waste disposal.

Mulching is particularly useful during regular mowing when only a small amount of grass is being removed.

Side Discharge for Tougher Conditions

When faced with longer, thicker, or damp grass, the side discharge function provides an efficient alternative to collection. Rather than forcing large volumes of grass into the collection box, clippings are discharged from the side of the mower.

This helps to:

  • Reduce the risk of blockages.
  • Maintain airflow through the cutting deck.
  • Improve performance in challenging mowing conditions.
  • Allow faster progress when cutting overgrown areas.

The side discharge feature is ideal for paddocks, rougher areas, or when bringing an overgrown lawn back under control.

Easy Pull Start System

The JET51-AD features an easy pull-start mechanism designed to get you mowing quickly and with minimal effort. The reliable starting system reduces resistance when pulling the starter cord, making the mower easier and more comfortable to start, even after periods of storage.

Three Mowing Options in One Machine

The Chipperfield JET51AD gives you the flexibility to choose the best mowing method for your lawn and conditions:

Collect – For a clean, tidy finish with clippings stored in the grass box.

Mulch – For nutrient-rich lawn care without collecting clippings.

Side Discharge – For tackling longer or heavier grass with maximum efficiency.

Built for Medium to Large Gardens

Designed with larger lawn areas in mind, the JET51AD combines a wide cutting deck, practical grass handling options, and easy operation to help homeowners achieve excellent results with less effort. Whether you’re carrying out routine weekly maintenance or dealing with more demanding mowing conditions, the JET51-AD delivers the versatility and performance you need.

Key Features at a Glance

✓ 51cm (20″) wide cutting deck
✓ Ideal for medium to large gardens
✓ Large grass collection box
✓ Grass box full indicator
✓ Mulching capability with included mulch plug
✓ Side discharge function for long and thick grass
✓ Easy pull-start system
✓ Three mowing modes: collect, mulch, or side discharge
✓ Efficient and versatile lawn care solution

The Chipperfield JET51AD is the perfect choice for homeowners looking for a dependable, feature-packed mower that can adapt to a variety of lawn conditions while delivering a clean, professional finish.
